name: WF-082 Autonomous Communication Authorization & Dispatch Gate

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const s=v=>String(v??'').trim(); const arr=v=>Array.isArray(v)?v:[]; const channel=s(input.channel??input.type).toLowerCase(); const recipient=s(input.recipient??input.to); const message=s(input.message??input.body); const account=s(input.account??input.sender_identity??'business'); const autoAllowed=input.autonomous_communication_enabled===true||input.auto_send_enabled===true; const recipientSuppressed=input.do_not_contact===true||input.dnc===true; const approval=s(input.approval_state).toLowerCase(); const provider=s(input.provider).toLowerCase(); const id=s(input.request_id??input.external_id); const gaps=[]; if(!id)gaps.push('request_id'); if(!['sms','email'].includes(channel))gaps.push('supported_channel_sms_or_email'); if(!recipient)gaps.push('recipient'); if(!message)gaps.push('message'); if(!provider)gaps.push('provider'); if(!autoAllowed)gaps.push('autonomous_communication_enabled'); const blocked=recipientSuppressed||gaps.length>0; const dispatchAllowed=!blocked; const mode=autoAllowed?'autonomous_opt_in':'human_approval';
